Verified via Playwright at 1920x1080 (+1536x864 ~125% zoom, 20px root font, 390x844 mobile). (2) Driver (driver1@test.com): /jobs renders 3 available jobs, Accept and Decline are exactly 56px tall (h-14) and clickable; accepted job 79fd58a3 -> /delivery/{id} full flow worked end-to-end: Stage 1 Pickup (full address revealed, Confirm Pickup 56px correctly disabled until all 3 checklist boxes ticked) -> Stage 2 In Transit (toast 'Pickup confirmed - custody recorded', dropoff address shown) -> Arrived at dropoff -> Stage 3 Delivery (signature canvas draw + recipient name) -> Mark Delivered -> Delivered summary 'Gross $52.50 - commission $10.50 = net $42.00'; /earnings loads with pay-period card and trip history including the new trip. (3) Facility (facility1@test.com): portal + Book Transport render; booking with both consent checkboxes submitted successfully (toast 'Request created - 2.7 km, driver payout $25.00'), appeared in My Deliveries with plaintext recipient; Billing tab renders statement table (subtotal $120.00, HST $15.60, total $135.60). (4) Dispatcher (dispatcher1@test.com): /dispatch renders all 7 columns (open-pool, offered, accepted, picked-up, in-transit, delivered, exceptions), 7 board cards, job dialog opens with status/route/payout + chain-of-custody section, assign flow works (toast 'Job offered to driver', card moved Open Pool -> Offered). (5) Admin: Users (7 rows), Drivers (badges + Review), Facilities, Revenue (4 tables, CSV buttons), Compliance (residency card, audit-integrity card, audit log) all render with correct styling, no unstyled/overlapping content. (6) ZERO console errors on all 5 main pages. (7) Layout robustness: no horizontal scroll and no clipped/overflowing elements at 1536px-wide viewport (=125% zoom of 1920), at 20px root font, or at 390px mobile (accept buttons still 56px). Issues found are a11y/design only: keyboard focus indicator on buttons/inputs is effectively invisible (RCA below) and several slate-400 micro-copy strings fail WCAG AA contrast, which contradicts the stated AA goal of the design pass.

issues: The new global rule `*:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0369a1 }` in index.css NEVER applies to buttons or inputs: the shadcn variants include `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring` and a class utility beats the universal selector. Measured on keyboard focus: Accept button and Sign In button -> outline '2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0)' (transparent) with box-shadow ring 'rgb(3,105,160) 0 0 0 1px'. Because ring-ring is now the SAME clinical blue as the primary button fill (#0369a1) and there is no ring-offset, the focus ring on every primary/filled button is invisible (verified in screenshot - no perceivable change when focused). Inputs get only a 1px ring (below the 2px the design pass intended). Links DO get the correct 2px #0369a1 outline. Fix: use `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2` in button.jsx/input.jsx, or drop `focus-visible:outline-none` so the global outline wins.

critical_code_review_comments: index.css adds `*:focus-visible { outline }` but every shadcn control already sets `focus-visible:outline-none`; a universal selector can never beat a utility class, so the a11y intent silently fails on all buttons/inputs. Focus styling belongs in the component variants (or in the CVA base string), not in a universal rule.

ring-ring was remapped to the same hue as --primary (201 96% 32%). A focus ring that equals the primary button fill and has no ring-offset is invisible by construction - keep ring-offset-2 whenever ring color can match a filled background.

The design pass changed the palette but left ~10 slate-400 micro-copy usages that were already sub-AA; a one-off contrast audit over rendered text (like the one used here) should be part of the design pass checklist before claiming AA.

rca_of_the_issue: Focus-indicator regression RCA: index.css line 27 adds `*:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0369a1; outline-offset: 2px }`, but components/ui/button.jsx and input.jsx base classes contain `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring`. Tailwind's outline-none compiles to `outline: 2px solid transparent`, and a class selector has higher specificity than the universal selector, so buttons/inputs keep a transparent outline and fall back to a 1px box-shadow ring. Since --ring was remapped to the same value as --primary (201 96% 32% = #0369a1) and no ring-offset is applied, the 1px ring is drawn in the same colour as the primary button's own background - measured box-shadow 'rgb(3,105,160) 0 0 0 1px' on a rgb(3,105,161) button - making keyboard focus imperceptible on every primary CTA (Sign In, Accept, Confirm Pickup, Mark Delivered).
